mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_conversation_messages ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, content TEXT, tool_calls_json TEXT, result_json TEXT, suggestions_json TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_conversation_messages_conversation_time ON agent_conversation_messages(conversation_id, created_at ASC, id ASC)
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, tool_calls_json, result_json, suggestions_json, created_at FROM agent_conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
